drone: Simulated drone concept: rockfall zone suspected, not verified
orbital: Plan unverified: small hazards are below orbital resolution
rover: Rover stopped: wheel slip 38 percent, requesting input

sensor_evidence.thermal: simulated thermal camera: surface cooler than surroundings (possible loose material)

stages.text: A first route from NASA orbital data. Large slopes and the rockfall zone are visible; small hazards are not.
stages.title: Orbital planning

stages.text: The day before the walk, the rover drives the main route out and the backup route back. It finds soft ground the orbit could not see and the route is replanned.
stages.title: Rover reconnaissance

stages.text: The simulated drone launches from the rover and images the scarp face and the areas the rover cannot reach, checking whether the observation point sits outside the rockfall zone.
stages.title: Drone inspection

stages.text: Review the proposed route two astronauts would walk to the observation point, the reconnaissance evidence behind it, and the backup route home. The simulated drone watches the scarp. None of this is crew clearance.
stages.title: Astronaut mission review

rules.limitations: Planning model, not certified crew or rover safety limits. DTM cannot resolve sub-metre obstacles. Unknown terrain requires inspection.

rockfall_height_factor.source: Team second-pass guidance: max(visible apron distance, one measured scarp height) from foot; not NASA-certified; reviewed edge/foot geometry required

roughness_m.source: Local elevation range; vertical uncertainty unavailable, so interpretation is uncertain; nearest odd pixel window approximates 3 m

rover_exclude_deg.source: Reported Perseverance figure, not a certified limit for Brianna's conceptual JPL Open Source Rover; replace from team CAD/sensor specifications when supplied

wheel_drop_m.source: Perseverance example; sensor only, below DTM resolution; not evaluated by orbital algorithms; Brianna's CAD dimensions pending

wheel_slip_pct.source: disc-001 scenario; stop and request human input
